releases.name: What Next? v3.0.0-b117
releases.body:
What Next? v3.0.0-b117

🚀 Upgrade Summary

This release introduces a major upgrade to the Anime & Manga list experience, with four layout styles, improved list customisation, long-press quick view, and personalised backgrounds.

✨ What's New

1. Four List Layout Styles

- Linear: Covers and title details displayed horizontally.
- Grid: Customisable 2, 3 or 4-column grid.
- Simplified: Minimal text-only layout without downloading cover images.
- Album: Large cover artwork with titles and progress displayed over the image.

2. Long-Press Quick View

- Long-press any Anime or Manga entry to open its quick view.
- View title, status, score, priority and personal notes.
- Update episode or chapter progress using +1 and -1.
- Open the full media page directly from quick view.

3. Advanced List Customisation

New options under Customise List:

- Enable or disable long-press quick view.
- Hide unscored titles.
- Hide progress information.
- Hide airing indicators.
- Display Notes indicators.
- Display Priority indicators with Low, Medium and High labels.

4. Personalised Background Images

- Select a picture from your device.
- Apply it as the background for Anime and Manga lists.
- Images are automatically resized and compressed before being saved.
- Remove the custom background whenever you like.
- Background preferences remain saved even after signing out.

⚙️ Under-the-Hood Improvements

- Extended AniList list data integration to include notes and priority.
- Improved local list updates and caching for additional entry information.
- Updated application resource revision to prevent mixing older and newer cached files.
- Added the updated project website link to application configuration.
- Updated project documentation and list customisation descriptions.

📲 Installation & Compatibility

- Direct upgrade supported.
- No need to uninstall the previous version.
- Uses the same signing key as previous releases.

releases.name: What Next? v3.0.0-b114
releases.body:
🚀 What Next? v3.0.0-b114

A major UI and usability update focused on improving the List Editor, refreshing the overall interface, and making everyday navigation smoother.

✨ What's New

🎨 Major UI Upgrade

- Extensive visual improvements across the application.
- Redesigned Anime and Manga list screens.
- Improved spacing, layouts, typography, buttons and visual consistency.
- Updated recommendation cards with a cleaner presentation.
- Improved title pages with sharper banner images and gradient transitions.

🛠️ List Editor Fixes & Improvements

- Fixed issues in the list editing experience.
- Redesigned the editor with organized card-based sections.
- Added a cover image and title information to the editor header.
- Improved status selection with colour indicators.
- Enhanced episode and chapter progress controls.
- Added an All button to instantly complete progress.
- Added clearer progress percentages and remaining counts.
- Improved score selection, priority controls and privacy toggle.
- Refined dates, rewatches/rereads, custom lists and notes.
- Improved Save and Remove controls.

📚 Anime & Manga Lists

- Redesigned the list toolbar with four dedicated controls:
  - Search
  - Filter
  - Customise
  - Custom Lists
- Added a sticky status filter row with colour indicators and entry counts.
- Improved list cards, status badges and progress bars.
- Updated the +1 progress button with a new gradient appearance.
- Reduced initial rendering from 48 to 24 titles.
- Show More now loads the next 24 titles.

📡 Anime Airing Indicators

- Added upcoming episode information directly to anime cards.
- Displays the number of unwatched released episodes (e.g. 3 new).
- Shows upcoming episode numbers and countdowns (e.g. Ep 8 · 2d).
- Hides airing indicators for completed and dropped titles.

🎲 Pick Screen Improvements

- Reorganized recommendation controls.
- Improved recommendation cards with score, format and genre chips.
- Added a clearer Up Next section.
- Improved watch/read duration and progress information.
- Refined recommendation action buttons.

📺 Media Page Improvements

- Sharper banner presentation.
- Improved banner-to-content gradient transitions.
- Better poster positioning and statistics card layout.
- Improved fallback appearance when a banner is unavailable or invalid.

⚙️ Stability & Development

- Added "package-lock.json" for more consistent dependency installations.
- Updated UI regression and robustness tests.
- Added dedicated end-to-end checks for the upgraded interface.

releases.name: What Next? v3.0.0-b94
releases.body:
🚀 What Next? v3.0.0-b94

<badge>PRE-RELEASE · TESTING BUILD</badge>

Welcome to What Next? Version 3.0.0!

This release introduces a new Discord card customization system for AniList Triple Sync, bringing dedicated visual styles to different anime and manga categories.

✨ What's New

1. Discord Themed Update Cards

Introducing category-specific Discord update cards!

🌀 Isekai Theme

- Dedicated violet/purple visual design.
- Custom gem-style progress bar.
- Isekai-inspired titles and descriptions.
- Quest-style progress and status labels.
- Special completion message.

💕 Rom-Com Theme

- Dedicated pink visual design.
- Heart-style progress bar.
- Romantic-themed titles and descriptions.
- Custom status descriptions.
- Special completion message.

2. Custom Theme Detection

- Automatically detects supported categories from custom AniList list names.
- Isekai, Iseki and Tensei lists receive the Isekai theme.
- Rom Com and Romantic Comedy lists receive the Rom-Com theme.
- Unmatched lists continue using standard Discord cards.
- Themed cards only apply to lists configured to receive their own Discord threads.

3. New Discord Customization Settings

Added new controls under:

Settings → AniList Triple Sync → Discord

- Enable or disable themed cards.
- Choose Standard, Isekai or Rom-Com for test cards.
- Preview different card appearances through the existing test buttons.
- Keep General Updates cards separate from category-specific themed threads.

4. Testing & Reliability

- Added dedicated unit tests for Discord card themes.
- Expanded Triple Sync end-to-end tests.
- Tested category detection, theme selection, progress bars and Discord card formatting.
- Improved release documentation.

---

🧪 Pre-release Notice

This is an experimental build of What Next? v3.0.0.

It is intended for testing and feedback before a stable release.

You may encounter unexpected behaviour or bugs. Please report any issues through GitHub Issues.

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b91
releases.body:
🚀 What Next? v2.1.1-b91

✨ What's New

1. Smart Cache System

- Introduced a new persistent local caching system.
- Faster loading of previously visited pages and saved content.
- Cached lists, profiles and statistics remain available offline.
- Previously opened anime and manga pages load instantly while refreshing their data in the background.
- Automatic cache cleanup based on data age:
  - Media cards and pages: 3 days.
  - Airing calendar: 7 days.
  - Account data and lists: 14 days.
- Improved storage management with automatic cache cleanup when storage becomes full.

2. Improved Performance & API Management

- Introduced an AniList API request pacing system.
- Automatically manages request frequency based on AniList's rate limits.
- Handles temporary API failures, timeouts and rate-limit responses.
- Reserves request capacity for tracking and saving progress.
- Improved network error handling and retry behaviour.

3. Session & Account Management

- Automatic sign-out after 14 days of inactivity.
- Account-specific cached data is cleared when switching AniList accounts.
- Improved logout and account cleanup.
- Pending tracking changes get a final synchronization attempt before automatic sign-out.
- Added manual cache clearing under Settings → Account.

4. New About Screen

- View installed application version and build information.
- Check for the latest stable release directly through GitHub.
- Read release notes inside the application.
- Added Open Source Licenses section.
- Added Privacy Policy access.
- Added configurable social and project links.

5. Improved AniList Settings

- Added timezone configuration.
- Added an option to use the phone's timezone.
- Expanded notification preferences with individual notification controls.
- Added support for the Always activity merge setting.
- Improved custom profile colour handling.
- Better cache invalidation when account preferences change.

6. Rich Text & Spoiler Support

- Improved AniList descriptions and profile biography rendering.
- Added Markdown formatting support:
  - Bold and italic.
  - Strikethrough.
  - Inline code.
  - Clickable links.
- Added tap-to-reveal spoiler support.
- Supports nested and multiline spoilers.
- Safer rendering of AniList-provided text.

7. Login & Application Improvements

- Improved native Android AniList login using application deep links.
- Improved application startup and cached Pick restoration.
- Removed legacy web service worker and cache registrations.
- Updated application loading and resource management.

8. Quality & Reliability

- Added dedicated cache and API pacing unit tests.
- Added session and offline cache end-to-end tests.
- Added About screen testing.
- Expanded settings and application stability tests.

releases.name: What Next? v2.1.1-b75
releases.body:
What Next? v2.1.1-b75

Official Android Release | Build 75

What Next? is an unofficial AniList-powered anime and manga companion designed to help you discover, organise, track, and manage your anime and manga journey.

This release is being published as a fresh GitHub release following the removal of previous release entries. It provides a clean release record for build 75.

✨ About What Next?

What Next? goes beyond a traditional anime tracking application. It combines personalised recommendations, intelligent time-based suggestions, advanced library management, anime discovery, seasonal schedules, statistics, and social features in one application.

🌟 Main Features

  • Smart Recommendations: Discover anime and manga based on your personal interests, genres, themes, and AniList activity.
  • Time-Based Picks: Find something to watch or read depending on your available time.
  • Anime & Manga Tracking: Manage your Watching, Completed, Planning, Paused, Dropped, and Reading lists.
  • Advanced Discovery: Explore anime, manga, characters, staff, studios, and AniList users.
  • Seasonal Anime: Browse anime by release year, season, and format.
  • Release Calendar: Track upcoming episodes, premieres, and season finales.
  • Taste Reports: Analyse your preferences, favourite genres, themes, ratings, and viewing personality.
  • Detailed Statistics: Explore your anime and manga progress, ratings, genres, demographics, and activity.
  • Franchise Relation Maps: Explore connections between anime and manga franchises.
  • User Profiles: View AniList profiles, followers, following lists, and user statistics.
  • Private Messaging: Communicate with other AniList users through the built-in chat.
  • Advanced List Editor: Manage scores, progress, dates, rewatches, priorities, notes, favourites, and custom lists.
  • AniList & MyAnimeList Synchronisation: Advanced AniList Triple Sync functionality.
  • Offline Support: Access previously saved information when an internet connection is unavailable.
  • Personalisation: Anime-inspired themes, interface customisation, privacy options, and more.
